illustration: Use case: isolated production sprite for a dark fantasy turn-based dungeon game. The provided orc game sprite is a reference for the RENDERING STYLE ONLY, not the body, species, gender, armor or pose. Draw a new original adult female dark elf assassin, unmistakable feminine angular face, narrow athletic body, tall sharp ears sticking out on each side of her head, slate-purple gray skin, conspicuous silver-white hair tied in a single heavy braided ponytail swept out towards back-left, cool pale eyes with deep ink shadows. The silhouette's focal point is her pale hair against dark desaturated aubergine and near-black leather brigandine, worn wine-red sash, flat stitched seams, small dull silver buckles, short layered waist flaps and calf boots. She holds exactly TWO distinct short daggers, one visibly in each hand, modest wide triangular blades, dull steel with small tarnished silver edges. Full body in readable crouched combat readiness, three-quarter profile facing screen right, one foot slightly ahead of the other, both feet on the same ground baseline, knees bent. Both elbows flare out from the torso and gap shows between arms and the waist, hands near belt height and blades pointing down/outward. Make silhouette anatomically distinct, arms and legs separable, no full cape or trailing cloth to occlude limbs, braid distinct from body silhouette. Both hands, both knife tips, entire braid, both feet completely inside the alpha canvas with comfortable margins. Same specific Darkest Dungeon 1 visual tradition as reference: massive black angular ink shadow shapes, thick hand-drawn outlines, limited graphic planes, dry etched texture, desaturated local color, worn authentic medieval fantasy, harsh shadows, sharp stylized silhouette. No realistic polished 3D lighting, no anime, no outline glow, no gore, no action trails, no scenery, no background, no floor, no shadow, no label. One centered original game asset on true transparent alpha. Full-body square sprite.

edits.underpaint: Use the attached original dark elf assassin sprite as identity, exact angular ink drawing style, and materials reference. Create an exploded production paint sheet of FOUR isolated, thick-ink cutouts on genuine transparent alpha with gaps. Strict 2×2 reading order. TOP LEFT: same bare gray-violet neck base and upper leather cuirass, including concealed round shoulder socket and side chest panels completed on both sides below her high peaked collar, without arms. TOP RIGHT: matching two upper sleeves shown together but separate, including hidden rounded shoulder overlap with the same black leather, gray purple planes and stitched seam. BOTTOM LEFT: same belt, dark leather hips and the upper thighs completed underneath her red sash, front sash removed so the leather can fill the hip seams. BOTTOM RIGHT: the matching two purple dagger gripping hands together but separate, with attached small brown wrapped leather wrist tabs that extend beyond the cutoff. Same three-quarter right-facing view and same exact colors, dark gray violet midtones, hand painted grain, flat ink. No whole assembled character, no text, no grid lines, no background. The purpose is to sample these painted textures to fill small hidden overlap regions in the original 2D cutout character. Landscape.
edits.dusk_lunge: Repaint EXACTLY the adult female dark elf in the attached original full-body game sprite. Match her lavender slate skin, pointed ear with two hoops, single long silver-white braid and leather brigandine with wine-red sash, same two identical silver daggers. Style and line weight must stay identical, thick black angular planes and dry hatching in the original Darkest Dungeon spirit. Draw a single full-body key posture for her fast right-facing dash thrust. Her leading leg drives far to screen right, trailing leg stretched low to the left, torso inclined forward to make a long low triangular silhouette. The nearer arm extends far forwards almost straight at chest height, one clenched hand holding a SILVER short dagger whose visible blade points horizontally to the right. Her other dagger is clearly visible in her other hand along the rear hip, it points down and back. Silver braid streams behind her to the left, bent knees and angled feet show decisive forward momentum. Keep both weapons, braid and all limbs in frame. Single sprite with transparent alpha, no afterimage, FX, shadow, floor, scenery, vignette, victims, blood, labels or borders. Landscape composition with padding.
edits.crescent_cut: Repaint a SINGLE full body transparent videogame combat keyframe of the exact same dark elf assassin woman as reference, with angular slate-purple face, pointed ear with small hoops, SAME large braided white ponytail, same worn leather and dark red sash and exactly two silver daggers. Three-quarter facing right. She makes a low spinning double-dagger slash: hips drop, front knee bent sharply, rear boot sweeping wide, ribbon and white braid sweeping left with circular motion. Both arms and two daggers plainly legible, the forward nearer dagger follows an upward arc to the right, the other dagger in the farther hand is held across waist level with blade pointed out towards right at a noticeably different elevation. Strong asymmetrical corkscrew, entirely different from a straight lunge, face glaring toward far right. All feet, blades and hair in the transparent canvas with comfortable margin. No rendered FX, motion traces, shadow, ground, scenery, other character, gore or text. Landscape.
edits.dead: Create a single transparent defeated key pose for the very same adult female dark elf assassin in the reference. Same single bright silver braid, slate-purple skin and pointed ears, same ink-etched near-black leather armor and wine-red long sash, same two short silver daggers. She is collapsed on her side, head on the right and boots to the left, both knees bent, hair spread out behind her head, chin tucked and eyes closed. Her hands are limp and each dagger is beside a hand, both weapons distinguishable. A low horizontal silhouette entirely within frame and on a consistent implied ground plane. Same Darkest Dungeon-style massive black ink planes and dark colors with dry grain, no reinterpretation or ornament. Quiet defeated pose, no injuries, blood, FX, scene, typography, floor line, or shadow. True transparency and wide landscape composition.
